tile-installation/sarasota.title: Tile Installation Sarasota FL | Porcelain & Showers
tile-installation/sarasota.description: Tile installers for Bird Key waterfront homes, Gulf Gate terrazzo restoration and Pinecraft baths in Sarasota, FL. TCNA prep, 2026 pricing.
tile-installation/sarasota.lede: A Bird Key primary bath, a Gulf Gate kitchen with terrazzo hiding under the tile, a Pinecraft rental needing a quick reset: tile work in Sarasota rarely looks the same twice.
tile-installation/sarasota.capsule: Tile installation in Sarasota ranges from restoring or replacing worn terrazzo in 1950s–1970s Gulf Gate and Bee Ridge ranches to large-format porcelain and Kerdi shower systems in the waterfront homes of Bird Key, Lido Key and St. Armands. Typical 2026 installed ranges run $6 to $22 per sq ft depending on format and material, with showers priced separately.
tile-installation/sarasota.body_html:
Pulling up old tile in a Gulf Gate or Bee Ridge kitchen is where a lot of our Sarasota tile jobs actually start, and it's not unusual to find intact terrazzo underneath a layer that was glued down sometime in the 1980s. We flag that during the estimate, because a terrazzo grind-and-reseal is a different scope and often a smaller bill than a full tile replacement. Where the original slab surface isn't salvageable, we set new porcelain with the crack-isolation membrane a slab that's already forty or fifty years old usually needs, following the same TCNA-spec prep we'd use on new construction.

Bird Key, Lido Key and St. Armands are the other end of the Sarasota market: large-format porcelain, 24-inch and up, set flat across open living areas, and primary bathrooms that call for a Schluter Kerdi or Wedi shower system rather than a traditional mortar pan. AE and VE flood zone designations are common on these keys, which is one more reason we favor porcelain and waterproof membrane systems over anything with a fiber-cement base near the water. A 600 sq ft living-area retile paired with a primary bath shower rebuild is a fairly typical scope on a Bird Key renovation, and we schedule around the same freight and staging logistics a waterfront home usually requires.

Pinecraft and the smaller homes around Arlington Park tend toward simpler scopes: a hall bath reset, a rental unit's kitchen backsplash, a cracked tile or two after a slow plumbing leak. If you searched flooring companies near me from anywhere south of downtown, we cover all of it from the same crew. See tile installation for how we handle substrate prep and lippage control on large-format work, and our floor repair page covers the hollow or cracked tile calls that come up often in Gulf Gate kitchens. For terrazzo specifically, ask us about it at the estimate; it isn't a service we've built a dedicated landing page for yet, but it's routine work in this part of the county.
tile-installation/sarasota.cost_html: A 600 sq ft Bird Key living-area retile in 24-inch porcelain runs $9 to $15 per sq ft, a typical 2026 installed range of $5,400 to $9,000, and a Schluter Kerdi shower system in the primary bath adds $1,800 to $3,800 on top of that. A Gulf Gate kitchen retile in standard 12-to-18-inch porcelain or ceramic, roughly 250 sq ft, runs $6 to $10 per sq ft, or $1,500 to $2,500 installed. Removing old glued tile with thinset chip-out first adds $2.50 to $4.50 per sq ft. These are typical 2026 ranges for Sarasota and Manatee County, not quotes, and the free in-home estimate confirms slab condition and format before we finalize a number.

faqs.q: Should I restore terrazzo or install new tile in my Gulf Gate home?
faqs.a: It depends on condition. If the original terrazzo under your existing floor is intact, a grind-and-reseal usually costs less than a full tile replacement and Sarasota buyers pay a premium for original terrazzo at resale. We check during the free estimate before recommending either path.

faqs.q: What shower system do you use on Bird Key and Lido Key?
faqs.a: Schluter Kerdi or Wedi waterproofing systems on most primary baths, since both are rated for the humidity and flood-zone exposure common along the Bird Key and Lido Key waterfront, and both hold up better than a traditional mortar-bed pan over time.

faqs.q: Can you match a repair to my existing Sarasota tile?
faqs.a: Usually, yes, for common formats and standard colors. If your tile is discontinued, which happens often in older Pinecraft and Arlington Park homes, we source the closest match and place it where the difference is least visible.
